about.description: COSX is the tokenized interest in COSIMO X Blockchain Opportunities Fund, an evergreen venture vehicle designed to provide exposure to early‑stage blockchain opportunities with a multi‑year horizon. The fund invests globally (U.S., Europe, and Asia) and typically targets seed through Series A rounds, structuring investments as preferred equity and/or tokens depending on the opportunity. The COSX token provides a digital representation of fund ownership onchain while portfolio value is driven by the off‑chain venture holdings and the manager’s NAV reporting. COSIMO X has described mechanisms such as token buybacks and retirements in connection with realized exit proceeds, linking long‑term token value to portfolio monetization.
